newsitem.title: USA: ITT picked over Hilton for San Antonio hotel.
newsitem.headline: ITT picked over Hilton for San Antonio hotel.

text.p: ITT Corp said its Sheraton unit was selected over Hilton Hotels Corp to develop and operate a new $198 million, 1,200-room hotel and convention center in San Antonio, Texas.
ITT said it will invest up to $80 million in the project -- Sheraton Riverwalk San Antonio Hotel -- over a three year period and will finance the remaining balance.
ITT's Sheraton was selected by the City Council of San Antonio, ITT said, scoring an 88 in the city council's 100-point evaluation while Hilton scored 65.
ITT rejected Hilton's January offer to buy ITT for a combination of cash and stock worth $6.5 billion.
